name: Breakout retest — momentum pause (1h)
rationale: After a 1h break to a range high with a confirmed trend (ADX high), a SHALLOW short-lookback pullback (a small-magnitude recent return that is negative but not a reversal) marks the retest of the breakout level — the classic re-entry where the breakout holds and continues. Requiring range_position still high ensures the retest has not failed. The other side is the breakout-fader who assumes the pullback is a failure and shorts into a continuation. Edge persists because breakout-retests are a well-known but hard-to-time continuation setup; the multi-condition timing captures it cleanly. Distinct from all specs: it entries on a controlled pause after a breakout, not on the breakout or the trend alone. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX falls under the exit floor (trend lost) or the stop fires if the retest breaks down.
catalyst: shallow retest of a confirmed breakout level
